description: What each organisation sent over the last {jours} days, and what receivers did with it. Relational emails (sign-in link, appointments, shares) are never counted or paused here.
liste_repoussoir_explication: Addresses burned for the WHOLE service: a hard bounce or a complaint at one organisation closes the address everywhere, because reputation is shared. Only fingerprints are kept, never the addresses.
seuils: Automatic pause above {plainte}% complaints or {rebond}% bounces over {jours} days, from {volume} messages sent — below that, a rate means nothing. Resuming is manual: a pause means there is a list to clean.
suspendre_confirmation_texte: Running waves stop after the current batch and will not resume on their own. Relational emails keep going.
